sample_unit: translated discharge instruction sets (4 topics x 3 languages x 3 tools)

links.outcome: AI translation quality of discharge instructions by target language and tool
links.effect: Overall scores similar (ChatGPT-4 3.79, Copilot 3.60, Google Translate 3.50); Albanian ChatGPT-4 3.75 vs Google Translate 3.19 (P<.001); no other significant language differences.
links.quote: Albanian translation was an exception, with ChatGPT-4 scoring significantly higher (3.75) than Google Translate (3.19) (P < .001).

links.outcome: Potentially harmful errors in AI translations of discharge instructions for LEP patients
links.effect: Microsoft Copilot and Google Translate produced a total of five potentially harmful translation errors; none were identified for ChatGPT-4.
links.quote: Both Microsoft Copilot and Google Translate produced a total of five potentially harmful translation errors, whereas none were identified for ChatGPT-4.

unlisted_practices: Professional human medical translator review of AI-translated discharge instructions

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation by professional translators of AI translation tools (ChatGPT-4, Copilot, Google Translate) on emergency department discharge instructions across complexity levels and languages.
